title: The first full race weekend
description: I stopped watching only the Sunday race and started watching practice. That is where the sport actually opens up — you can see teams testing a theory instead of executing one.
teaser: I stopped watching only the Sunday race and started watching practice. That is where the sport actually opens up — you can see teams testing a theory instead of executing one.

title: Strategy over speed
description: The season where I realised the fastest car does not automatically win. Tyre windows, undercuts, safety car luck. I started thinking about races as resource problems.
teaser: The season where I realised the fastest car does not automatically win. Tyre windows, undercuts, safety car luck. I started thinking about races as resource problems.

title: Sim racing as a feedback loop
description: Driving badly on purpose to learn what a setup change actually does. Understeer is a much better teacher than a diagram.
teaser: Driving badly on purpose to learn what a setup change actually does. Understeer is a much better teacher than a diagram.

title: REDLINE
description: I built a go-kart racing platform: multi-branch booking, live leaderboards, tournaments. The first time the racing brain and the engineering brain were doing the same job.
teaser: I built a go-kart racing platform: multi-branch booking, live leaderboards, tournaments. The first time the racing brain and the engineering brain were doing the same job.
